canonical_statement: For an arbitrary family of continuous semilinear maps from a complete seminormed space E to a seminormed space F over compatible nontrivially normed fields, if for each x in E the real norms of all g_i(x) have a common upper bound depending on x, then the operator norms of all g_i have one common real upper bound.
domain_and_universes: universes uE uF uK uK2 uI; E : Type uE; F : Type uF; K : Type uK; K2 : Type uK2; I : Type uI; seminormed additive commutative groups E and F; nontrivially normed fields K and K2; NormedSpace K E; NormedSpace K2 F; sigma12 : K ->+* K2; RingHomIsometric sigma12; CompleteSpace E
ordered_binders: E, F, K, K2 and their seminormed/field/normed-space instances
sigma12 : K ->+* K2 and RingHomIsometric sigma12
I : Type uI and CompleteSpace E
pointwise boundedness premise, with x before its bound C
hypotheses: each g i is a continuous semilinear map
forall x : E, exists C : Real, forall i : I, norm (g i x) <= C
conclusion: exists C' : Real, forall i : I, norm (g i) <= C'
